dedupe_keys.name: new benchmark instances for the cross dock door assignment problem

description: These synthetic benchmark instances describe cross-dock freight transfers between incoming and outgoing trucks. Belen Melián-Bastista and collaborators publish them through the University of La Laguna repository to test the Cross-Dock Door Assignment Problem. Instances range from eight origins and destinations with four inbound and outbound doors to 50 origins and destinations with 30 doors. Pallet flows are sampled uniformly between 10 and 50, with specified flow densities. Door capacities include slack above the equal allocation of incoming flow. These inputs support optimisation of door assignment and network flow within a cross-dock terminal. They are generated test problems, with no established real-world geographic extent, observation period or temporal sampling resolution. The native inventory lists one RAR archive, CDAP_Instances.rar; the formats inside the archive are not stated. Version 1 is available through the repository landing page, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: no archive was retrieved or algorithm tested. The source names related benchmark-generation criteria from Nassief et al. (2016) and Sayed (2020). No related active resource identity or software interface was established.
